CCP_research_next_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.ccp_research_page < ccp_research_pages_last }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.ccp_research_page = 1 }
		CCP_research_load_page = yes
	}
}

CCP_research_prev_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.ccp_research_page > 0 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { global.ccp_research_page = 1 }
		CCP_research_load_page = yes
	}
}
